attorneys: Solicitor General Griswold, Arnold Ordman, Dominick L. Manoli, and Norton J. Come for petitioner in No. 573, and Albert Gore for petitioner in No. 691. Lewis P. Hamlin, Jr., for respondent General Steel Products, Inc., in No. 573.
